examples.name: Default
examples.summary: An inline MCP Apps widget, a plan picker, that starts with ui/initialize and asks for a tool call. The page answers the handshake, checks the tool against an allow-list and replies with post().

examples.name: Resolved URL
examples.summary: Two ui:// resources with no inline HTML: resolveUrl looks each uri up in a table the app owns, loads the known one from its https URL and blocks the unknown one, which shows the blocked state.

examples.name: Loading
examples.summary: A resource whose resolveUrl has not settled yet, so the frame keeps its loading state.
